title: Functions Quiz 4
description: Even, odd and the shifts that work backwards.
instructions: Read each question carefully, then check your answer.
Every question has a trap. Slow down at the signs.

questions.question: Which function is **even**?
questions.explanation: $f(-x)=x^2+\cos x=f(x)$. Watch out: $x^2+x$ mixes an even and an odd term, so it is neither.

questions.question: Which function is **odd**?
questions.explanation: $f(-x)=-x^3-\sin x=-f(x)$. Watch out: the constant in $x^3+1$ destroys oddness.

questions.question: $f(x)=x^{3}+1$ is an odd function.
questions.explanation: $f(-x)=-x^3+1$, which is neither $f(x)$ nor $-f(x)$. Watch out: constants are even terms.

questions.question: $f(x)=|x|$ is even.
questions.explanation: $|-x|=|x|$. Watch out: even functions are symmetric about the $y$-axis.

questions.question: The graph of $f(x+2)$ is the graph of $f(x)$ moved...
questions.explanation: Replacing $x$ by $x+2$ shifts left. Watch out: changes inside the brackets work backwards.

questions.question: The graph of $f(x)-3$ is the graph of $f(x)$ moved...
questions.explanation: Subtracting outside the function lowers every output by $3$. Watch out: this change is outside the bracket, so it works as written.

questions.question: What does $f(-x)$ do to the graph of $f(x)$?
questions.explanation: Each point $(a,b)$ becomes $(-a,b)$. Watch out: $-f(x)$ is the one that reflects in the $x$-axis.

questions.question: What does $f(2x)$ do to the graph of $f(x)$?
options: a shift to the left by two
questions.explanation: Inputs are doubled, so features arrive at half the distance. Watch out: doubling $x$ compresses, it does not stretch.

questions.question: Match each transformation with its effect.
questions.explanation: Outside changes act on $y$; inside changes act on $x$. Watch out: inside changes move opposite to the sign.

questions.question: The point $(3,4)$ is on $y=f(x)$. What is the $x$-coordinate of its image on $y=f(x-1)$?
questions.explanation: The graph moves right by $1$, so $(3,4)$ goes to $(4,4)$. Watch out: $f(x-1)$ shifts right.

questions.question: Which of these are even functions?
questions.explanation: $x^2$, $\cos x$ and $|x|$ are symmetric about the $y$-axis. Watch out: $\sin x$ and $x^3$ are odd.
